scope: Read-only audit of source205 true-residual/full-contact scopes plus source176 shipping preflight. No source edits, native run, or GPU dispatch.

findings.scopeGate: runtime.mm:10612-10671 rejects mixed/multiphysics flags, any rigidGeneralizedCapacity, support/vascular rows, and unknownCount other than 2*E*N; true-residual capability also bounds cohesive faces <=4096 and tetrahedra <=32768.
findings.rhs: runtime.mm:19990-20000 preserves the full layout.unknownCount residual, so RHS storage can hold generalized rows.
findings.certOperator: runtime.mm:23000-23172 clears operator scratch and dispatches FEM element, cohesive-face, FEM-node gather, and cohesive-node action, then measures. FEM gather includes continuum-side primal contact terms, but no mixed element/node or free-rigid/primal-rigid generalized-row action is dispatched in this certification branch.
findings.measure: fgmres.metalinc:5534-5630 loops mechanical and field nodal rows only; layout.unknownCount is not used to include rigid tail. Residual replacement also writes only nodal blocks.
findings.existingCoupledDiagnostic: runtime.mm:23200-23350 separately dispatches mixed element/node, free-rigid, and primal-rigid-contact actions with allowConvergedOperatorState=1, but it never feeds that operator into true-residual measurement. This proves those operators exist, not that the cert path is complete.
findings.fullContactScope: runtime.mm:10856-11150 is distinct: N<=8192/T<=32768 and permits one six-DOF free rigid body (unknownCount=2*E*N+6*E) under bounded contact conditions. Do not conflate it with true-residual scope N<=4096 and no generalized rows.

minimumTarget.configuration: E=1; one static explicit FEM object; no MPM, Human/articulated/support/vascular, or mixed multiphysics fields; one non-articulated free BOX; rigidGeneralizedCapacity=6; unknownCount=2*N+6.
steps: Kernel contract with no active contact: include six mass/inertia tail rows in b-Ax norm and residual replacement.
Kernel contract with one active FEM/BOX primal contact: verify FEM-side gather and generalized rigid reaction action against same-generation independent assembly.
One native transaction: certify fresh full-row true residual, then use unchanged nonlinear Armijo and commit/rollback rules; compare feature-off production history.
Only afterward consider mixed FEM field rows, requiring corresponding mixed element/node action and row-aware norm/restart semantics.
required: Permit only the exact one-free-body row layout.
Dispatch same-generation nm_fgmres_apply_free_rigid and nm_fgmres_apply_primal_rigid_contacts with true-residual latch bypass.
Measure/restart all supported scalar tail rows; retain rejection for unsupported row blocks.
Bind RHS, candidate/history, constraint, contact branch, row map, and operator generation.
limits: No implementation or native qualification in this audit.
No full-contact convergence, shipping-scale admission, or physical-assembly claim.

shipping.preflight: source176 CPU allocation model only; not an actual source205 native peak.
shipping.note: A D=131072, sparse K=65536, tiled-cohesive model can be estimated below 16 GiB, but current runtime admission remains N<=8192/T<=32768 and true-residual certification N<=4096/no rigid generalized rows. Device maxBufferLength and actual peak are not measured; overflow and admission remain open.

reproduction.method: Read-only line-bounded source inspection and SHA-256 bindings.
